scope: Five fixed dd-492 historical pdf_text_layer_required failures, real official downloads, local vie-only OCR, no accuracy assessment

boundaries.failure: Historical database, publication pointer, source configuration or bucket is changed
boundaries.expected: Only a fresh database, fresh bucket and work-local source/API settings are written

boundaries.failure: A slow, large, native or failed sample is silently replaced
boundaries.expected: Exactly the five preselected official URLs remain in the evidence, including failures

boundaries.failure: Official download, redirect, TLS, timeout, response cap or scope rejection
boundaries.expected: Preserve CLI/Observation failure; no claimed OCR or successful API content for failed input

boundaries.failure: Live original SHA-256 differs from historical archive_ref
boundaries.expected: Report byte mismatch explicitly; do not equate it with the historical document

boundaries.failure: Any pypdf page has extractable native text
boundaries.expected: Keep true native method and report that this sample did not exercise OCR; never force the branch

boundaries.failure: Invalid/encrypted PDF, page/pixel limit or renderer failure
boundaries.expected: Stable PDF failure and no successful Version

boundaries.failure: Missing local vie model, OCR subprocess error, timeout or empty whole-document output
boundaries.expected: Stable recognition failure and no successful Version; no cloud calls

boundaries.failure: Missing/reordered original page, dropped empty-text page or invented blank-page status
boundaries.expected: Exactly original page numbers 1..N retained with text strings and explicit empty-text positions

boundaries.failure: Original/CrawlResult CAS hash mismatch, absent original attachment, empty Markdown/HTML or missing successful Version
boundaries.expected: Fail the corresponding stored-content assertion and preserve diagnostic references

boundaries.failure: Snapshot publication, authentication, Results body/page metadata or original attachment download fails
boundaries.expected: Fail the API stage; compare API page text and Markdown against archived CrawlResult and original bytes against historical SHA-256

boundaries.failure: Owned API/OCR process or temporary PDF directory remains after acceptance
boundaries.expected: Stop owned processes, release temporary resources, retain isolated database and bucket for user recheck

boundaries.failure: Bearer, attachment capabilities or private service credentials enter artifacts
boundaries.expected: Artifacts contain redacted API attachments and public content only; secrets stay mode-0600 under work
